Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.filemanager

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.filemanager
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps
     
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ArchiveOperations
    Archive (compression) operations for the file manager, built entirely on the JDK's java.util.zip so a produced .zip opens in any unzip tool and any standard zip can be extracted here.
    FileManager
    The file manager application: the FileManagerPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
    FileManagerPanel
    The file manager's Swing UI: a directory JTree on the left and a JTable of the current directory on the right, with a toolbar (Back/Forward/Up/Home/Refresh, list/icon view, Close), a clickable breadcrumb, and a status bar.
    FileOperations
    Filesystem operations for the file manager, built on java.nio.file and the shared Opener (for trash / xdg-open).
    FileTableModel
    Table model listing the entries of one directory as rows with Name / Size / Type / Modified columns.
    ShareOperations
    Read-only network sharing for the file manager: serves a folder over HTTP so other machines on the LAN can browse and download it, using the JDK's built-in com.sun.net.httpserver.
    ShareOperations.Share
    A running HTTP folder share.
    VolumeOperations
    Removable-volume operations for the file manager: enumerate mountable block devices and mount / unmount them, shelling out to the standard Linux tools.
    VolumeOperations.OpResult
    The outcome of a mount / unmount attempt.
    VolumeOperations.Volume
    A mountable block device / partition discovered by lsblk.
